prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1283; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Pearland, Texas. I was going through on a green light, heading straight, when a car came out from the side street and hit my passenger side.

Q: Did the other driver stop or yield before entering the intersection?

A: No, from what I saw they didn't stop. They just pulled out in front of me. I braked but there wasn't time.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbags deployed on my side, though, and my head hit the window.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to the emergency room that same day. They diagnosed me with a concussion. I've been having headaches and I get dizzy when I'm reading or looking at screens for long periods.

Q: Are you currently following your doctor's recommendations?

A: Yes, I'm resting as much as I can and I've been told to avoid driving until my doctor clears me. I have an appointment with a neurologist next week.

Q: Did you miss any work because of the injury?

A: I've missed a few days so far. I work from a desk, so the screen time is hard on me.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still shaken up about it. I just want to get my car fixed and get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
